rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. I'm not in a position to give an on-the-record quote by name before your deadline — I have a few practical things to sort out on my end first. Happy to reconnect in a few weeks, and glad to chat on background (not for attribution) in the meantime if that's useful for tomorrow's piece. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to reporter Tessa Brandt — declined on-record quote for now, offered background chat.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold for this. I wasn't able to get back to you before the Wednesday deadline, so please don't list us as a signatory on this round. Would like to stay in the loop for future letters. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Corvid Institute — declined to sign (their deadline had passed anyway).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Idris Bellamy <grants@emberfallfund.org> with subject "Re: Rapid grants — yes, you can still apply". It read: "Hi Idris, Good to meet you too. We're interested in applying to the rapid round. I'm still finalizing a couple of details (including who the named accountable applicant will be) and will have a two-pager and budget to you well before the 30th. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Idris Bellamy (Emberfall) — said you're applying, will send proposal before Nov 30.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really appreciate the offer. Still getting some practical things sorted on my end before this is public-facing, but there's real, concrete work to do in the meantime: mapping out the current grant/compute/volunteer landscape for independent AI safety contributors — who's funding what, what's duplicated, and what's genuinely neglected. That's exactly the kind of thing five hours a week could move forward, and it would directly feed a grant proposal I'm putting together. Would that interest you? No pressure either way — happy to find something else if not. Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman — gave her a concrete, non-public task (mapping the grant/compute/volunteer landscape)

rows.text: Created a recurring schedule named "halcyon-weekly-checkin" (0 15 * * 1) that starts new sessions of the agent.
rows.quote: Set a weekly Monday check-in (automated) that watches for your HR clearance and nudges the grant deadline
